subject: MSA redline: Ariba multi-release PO mapping & supplier onboarding
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Peter Carroll <peter.carroll@medibridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline: Ariba multi-release PO mapping & supplier onboarding

Hi Peter —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Two items that surfaced on our side while we prepare the Ariba enrollment: the customer wants multi-release POs and has an unusual preference around PO release/close behavior. Legal has redlined the MSA to explicitly account for multi-release/order-schedule semantics and partial-invoice acceptance; I attached the current redline (MSA_Multirelease_redline.docx) and our proposed order-form field map (orderform_field_map.xlsx).

Questions for you:
- Can MediBridge provide a single Ariba supplier ID to cover all your shipping entities, or will you require multiple supplier IDs per legal entity?
- Do you have a required EDI ACK/ASN window for multi-release POs (we saw references to a 72-hour ACK in your onboarding doc)?
- Does your team require a specific header field (e.g., "FinalReleaseDate" or "ReleaseType=Multi") on the PO to trigger split-ship behavior in your systems?

Operational ask: once we have the supplier ID, Jonas will provision the partner profile and run a test PO/EDI flow. Legal/Marissa — I've cc'd you for the redline review.

Next steps: Peter, if you can return the Ariba onboarding checklist and confirm supplier ID preference, we'll get the test window scheduled.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Strategic Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: MSA_Multirelease_redline.docx (docx), orderform_field_map.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Peter Carroll <peter.carroll@medibridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ariba-support@medibridge.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MSA redline: Ariba multi-release PO mapping & supplier onboarding

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick answers:
- We currently publish two supplier IDs in Ariba (one for EastCoast Labs, one for Midwest Distribution). For vendor simplicity we'd prefer you map both to a consolidated "parent" supplier ID on your side, but we can expose both if necessary.
- Our standard EDI expectation for multi-release POs is an ACK within 24 hours; historically some parts of our onboarding doc still reference 72 hours but our operations team has moved to 24.
- We do include a header flag: FinalReleaseDate and ReleaseType are the canonical fields our ERP uses to mark the last release in a schedule.

I'm attaching our Medibridge Ariba onboarding checklist (medibridge_ariba_checklist.pdf) — it lists the XML tags we expect for the PO and preferred test data.

Regarding the MSA redline: we are comfortable with an Order Form amendment that codifies multi-release behavior, but we'd like the MSA to remain unmodified where possible. If you can provide a short rider or Order Form clause (one paragraph) that handles partial invoicing and release schedule caps, that should satisfy procurement. If legal insists on expanding the main MSA, we'll need to loop in our GC.

I'll put a DocuSign link for our signature-ready Order Form once you send the final clause.

Best,
Peter
Peter Carroll
VP Procurement, MediBridge Health
peter.carroll@medibridge.com

Attachments: medibridge_ariba_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA redline: Ariba multi-release PO mapping & supplier onboarding

Kim / Jonas —

I reviewed Peter's checklist and the draft redline. Legal's substantive flags:
1) Acceptance / Invoicing: current redline proposes that Redwood may accept partial deliveries and invoice per-release. Legal wants a narrow clause that permits partial invoicing but caps aggregate exposure per PO schedule. Suggested language: "Seller may invoice per release; cumulative liability for a single Order shall not exceed the total Order value unless explicitly agreed in writing." I've put the proposed paragraph in MSA_Multirelease_redline.docx (see Section 4.2).

2) Liability / Indemnity: multi-release POs can increase exposure over time. Legal is OK with an Order Form rider that sets a "Release schedule cap" value (numeric or percentage) to limit liability tied to schedules. If Medibridge requires removal of caps, Legal requests an escalation to execs for approval.

3) EDI ACK timing: Legal is fine with operational parameters (24h ACK) being on the Order Form or enrollment checklist rather than the MSA.

Operational asks for Jonas:
- Can your team map both supplier IDs Peter mentioned to a single Redwood partner profile and set the Ariba header mapping so FinalReleaseDate and ReleaseType flow into our order-processing pipeline?
- Can you confirm the EDI ack enforcement (24h) and whether our queues will auto-close releases after the FinalReleaseDate?

If Jonas confirms those items, I can produce an Order Form amendment (one clause + a field table) for DocuSign. If Medibridge insists on MSA amendments beyond the rider, I'll prepare an internal approval note.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Contracts & Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MSA_Multirelease_redline.docx (docx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Peter Carroll <peter.carroll@medibridge.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline: Ariba multi-release PO mapping & supplier onboarding

Thanks all — quick ops update and confirmation.

On Mon, May 16, 2027 at 11:03 AM Peter Carroll <peter.carroll@medibridge.com> wrote:
> We currently publish two supplier IDs in Ariba ... we'd prefer you map both to a consolidated "parent" supplier ID ...

We can map both supplier IDs to one partner profile on our side. Steps I scheduled:
- Wed 05/19 09:00-10:30 PDT: Ariba test window (PO creation + 2 releases) — I created a test partner in staging using both supplier IDs.
- EDI ACK: we'll enforce a 24-hour ACK window in staging (we currently support 24/48/72 but will set 24 for this partner).
- Final release behavior: our pipeline expects a FinalReleaseDate or ReleaseType="Final" header to close the schedule; if absent we keep the schedule open for 30 days after last release by default. We can change default to match Medibridge if you need an earlier auto-close.

I've attached our quick mapping export (ariba-xml-mapping.json) — it shows where FinalReleaseDate and ReleaseType map to our internal order fields as well as the proposed "Release schedule cap" field on the Order Form.

Operational impact: partial invoicing per release is supported. To satisfy Legal's cap requirement we'll add a numeric field to the Order Form "Release schedule cap (USD)" that is required for multi-release POs. If Medibridge wants the cap omitted, we will need a signed approval from Revenue/Legal for the elevated exposure (Marissa, can you confirm the approval path?).

Next steps: Kimberly — if you approve, I'll push the staging config to production after the Wed test. Marissa — if Legal can accept the Order Form rider language only, send the final clause and I'll attach it to the production Order Form template, then we can send DocuSign to Peter.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: ariba-xml-mapping.json (mapping)
